title: Deep Dive: Currency Interventions and Energy Updates
summary: Currency policy, energy, and rotation scenarios.
coverage_note: All source blocks and chart labels read. Covers liquidity, households, fiscal/election scenarios, currency mechanisms, digital assets, energy businesses, and equity rotation. Historical 2020 excerpt is not a new forecast. Excludes boilerplate and bare position lists.

framework_lessons: Trace funding channels before asset effects.
assessment: The near-term Treasury borrowing call clearly missed, while 2025 runoff cessation and the ETF/policy event calls held. Energy and rotation reasoning was materially less precise: organic international service growth weakened and oil prices fell during 2025. Numerous scenario and valuation propositions require definitions before binary scoring. The 2020 currency excerpt is explanatory reuse, not independent forecast evidence.

Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
